LanguageData.LP_AberrantPaste.label: aberrant paste
LanguageData.LP_AberrantPaste.description: A dark red paste of twisted meat boiled down with chemfuel and stabilized, kept in wax-sealed clay jars. The Far Realm infestation has been suppressed; it doesn't rot, but is still a little warm to the touch.\n\nAlchemists and necromancers both use it as concentrated "flesh": in the necromantic ritual table's raw meat recipes, 1 aberrant paste counts as 20 raw meat; in flesh catalysis, 1 counts as 10 twisted meat. Ordinary caravans don't buy it; infernal brokers, fey markets and hag markets buy it at 1.5× price.
LanguageData.LP_AberrantSalve.label: aberrant regenerative paste
LanguageData.LP_AberrantSalve.description: Aberrant paste mixed with herbs; applied to a wound, it burrows in and sews the flesh shut. Healing effect about the same as industrial medicine.\n\nThe price: each tending has a 15% chance to leave an "aberrant growth" on the treated part (beauty -1, can be surgically removed).
LanguageData.LP_MorphDraught.label: metamorphosis draught
LanguageData.LP_MorphDraught.description: A murky draught of aberrant paste cut with troll blood. For 12 hours after drinking, muscles and nerves "grow crooked" together: melee damage +20%, pain threshold +20%, but the face warps too, social impact -30%. Liches and necromantic constructs can't drink it.
LanguageData.LP_EyeOfHadar.label: Eye of Hadar
LanguageData.LP_EyeOfHadar.description: A shard of light from Hadar, the "Dark Hunger" star of the Far Realm, set in a withered eye-socket-shaped bone frame. Its wearer can see the tides of the Far Realm: psychic sensitivity +30%, meditation focus gain +20%, aiming time -10%; +15% damage against Far Realm entities and aberration enemies.\n\nThe price: it's always "hungry". The wearer's mental break threshold +6%. Worn on the eyes in the trinket layer.
LanguageData.LP_AberrantHideArmor.label: aberrant hide armor
LanguageData.LP_AberrantHideArmor.description: Armor with a leather base and aberrant paste "grown" on layer by layer; it feels alive to the touch. Sharp armor slightly below a flak vest. The wearer heals one small wound per day.\n\nUnsettling to look at: other people's opinion of the wearer -5.
